BiblicalUsage: Maadiah was a priest who returned with Zerubbabel, named among the heads of the priestly courses in the days of Nehemiah. His name stands in the record of the priests who served when the wall was dedicated and the worship of the temple was set in order.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the priests are named because God keeps the record of those who serve Him, even when the world has forgotten their faces.
